map.综合 AMH、基础 FSH/E2 与 AFC(窦卵泡计数)评估卵巢储备功能与生育: Combines AMH, basal FSH/E2 and AFC (antral follicle count) to assess ovarian reserve and fertility potential; AMH is not affected by the cycle and can be tested at any time, supporting preconception and reproductive counseling.
map.AMH 分级：<0.5 极低、<1.0 低、<3.5 正常、<6.0 偏高、≥: AMH grading: below 0.5 very low, below 1.0 low, below 3.5 normal, below 6.0 high, 6.0 or above very high; FSH below 10 is normal; AFC of 8 or more is normal
map.综合 AMH/FSH/AFC/年龄 评分，≥ 4 分提示卵工叶储减退(DOR)，: Combining AMH/FSH/AFC/age into a score, 4 or more indicates diminished ovarian reserve (DOR), and AMH above 6 indicates a high ovarian responder (PCOS).
map.联合 AMH、FSH、AFC、年龄四项评估储备。: Jointly assess the reserve with AMH, FSH, AFC and age.
map.预测 IVF 获卵数与反应。: Predict the number of eggs retrieved and the response in IVF.
map.提示 PCOS 高反应风险。: Indicates a high-responder risk in PCOS.
map.：AMH 0.6（<1 加 2 分）、FSH 18（≥15 加 3 分）、AFC: AMH 0.6 (below 1 adds 2 points), FSH 18 (15 or above adds 3), AFC 4 (below 5 adds 2), age 39 (35 or above adds 1): total 8 points, at or above 4, diagnosing diminished ovarian reserve (DOR).
map.：AMH 7.5（>6 减 1 分）、FSH 6、AFC 25、年龄 28：AM: AMH 7.5 (above 6 subtracts 1 point), FSH 6, AFC 25, age 28: high AMH indicates a PCOS high responder, and OHSS must be watched for in ART.
map.评分越高越差吗？: Does a higher score mean worse?
map.否，本评分是风险积分：AMH 低、FSH 高、AFC 少、年龄大均加分，总分越高: No, this score is a risk tally: low AMH, high FSH, few AFC and older age each add points, and the higher the total the poorer the reserve; very high AMH instead subtracts a point to flag a high responder.
map.DOR 还能怀孕吗？: Can I still get pregnant with diminished ovarian reserve?
map.能，但获卵少、妊娠率下降，建议尽早评估并考虑辅助生殖；仍有自然妊娠可能。: It is possible, but with fewer eggs retrieved and a lower pregnancy rate, so evaluate early and consider assisted reproduction; natural pregnancy is still possible.
